newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Oct 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Oct 17.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Thursday:
- Russian Chief of Staff Anatoly Chubais is trying to make the country's unruly government a disciplined state.
- U.S. President Bill Clinton's administration rejected accusations that he received illegal campaign contributions from Indonesia.
- Japanese Parliament candidates campaign with courtesy and aggressiveness as national elections approach.
- Britain's government has proposed to ban practically all privately-owned hand guns.
- U.S. federal regulators have difficulty preventing illegal foreign donations from being made to local election campaigns.
- Special U.S. courts are using drug rehabilitation and other tactics to handle drug cases, offering sentence reductions for those who comply with their obligations.
